result.description:
About Codafication
Codafication is a tech company located just off James Street in Brisbane’s Fortitude Valley. We have developed globally recognised solutions for the insurance and construction industries.  Our mission is to pioneer new ways to make the world simpler - and we are building solutions that streamline experiences for our customers making them more efficient and cost-effective. With deep domain knowledge and client partnerships across the trillion-dollar global insurance and construction industries, we are scaling our products and utilisation across Australia, New Zealand and into North America. 
Check us out at Codafication.com 
About the Role
No day is the same as a Customer Success Officer at Codafication! To succeed in this role you will be flexible in your daily activities, enjoy problem-solving and looking for new ways to help customers achieve success using Codafication’s tools. 

As the voice of our customers, you will play an important role in our business working closely with the Project Management, Business Analyst and Software Engineering teams to manage different projects to success. You will provide clear and empathetic customer service and technical support ensuring clients experience success with Codafication’s product offerings.

Your day-to-day duties will include: 

•	Delivering onboarding, training, coaching, and mentoring for customers
•	Building and maintaining strong business relationships with customers
•	Providing frontline support to customers and management of Jira support tickets
•	Building and maintaining high quality customer-facing materials and repositories (e.g. knowledge base library, FAQs, training packages)
•	Providing feedback, support, and updates to internal stakeholders to optimise the customer experience
•	Conducting workshops, demonstrations, training, and reviews of products with customers
•	Driving adoption and retention, while identifying opportunities for account growth and additional product placement


About you
As our successful candidate, you will demonstrate;
•	At least 3 years of relevant work experience
•	Technical experience would be advantageous
•	Excellent written and verbal skills 
•	Love for problem solving and thrive in a dynamic and fast paced environment
•	Ability to win trust and drive relationships to ensure best outcomes for customers and the business
•	Excellent resource management and planning skills
•	Highly motivated with a desire to learn and grow
•	Ability to resolve customer complaints, enquiries, and conduct basic troubleshooting quickly and efficiently

Life at Coda
•	Brand new Fortitude Valley Office bordering James Street Precinct
•	Quarterly staff functions - Celebrate our success as a team
•	Be recognised and rewarded for your achievements
•	Revitalise Days + Volunteer Leave giving you up to 4 extra leave days a year to do what you love
•	Regular 1-2-1 time with your leader to accelerate your career
•	Genuine career progression
•	Hybrid working environment to promote genuine work-life balance

If you want to be part of a winning team and this role suits you to a tee, I would love to hear from you. We do have an immediate start available however happy to wait for the right person given notice periods. 

Salary offered is $75k to $85k

Seeking a skilled Welder/ Metal Fabricator for fulltime employment with a background in the manufacturing & repair industry. 

The Company
We are like one big family here; our team members are the heart of our business. 
Sloanebuilt are a leading NSW trailer manufacturer.  Our team are committed to the future and have provided many job opportunities for the local community for over 40 years.
We offer opportunities to grow, develop, learn from and work alongside our world-class team of experts. We encourage a culture of respect and reward high performance with an emphasis on quality, performance and reliability.
Sloanebuilt is proud to have a very strong, loyal and committed workforce that is made up of around 140 local employees.
We pride ourselves on our Sloanebuilt values and look for them in each of our valued employees.

Roles to be filled  
We are seeking to appoint highly experienced & skilled candidates for full time employment with a background in the Metal Fabrication Industry for the following positions: 
	  Welders  who have experience in the welding of a variety of metals which may include mild steel, aluminum and stainless steel, using MIG, MMAW and TIG processes 
	  Metal Fabricators  whose experience includes reading of engineering drawings, fabrication of structural steel and other metal stock to make or repair metal products and welding of the fabrications. 
 
Requirements   
To be eligible for this role, applicants must: 
	 Be willing to work a 38 hour week plus overtime based on Company requirements 
	 Have 5 years work experience in a similar role 
	 Self motivated and able to work independently as required 
 These are specialised trades & 1st class tradespersons need only apply. 

The Candidate  
The successful candidate must be someone who prides themselves in producing high quality work with good interpersonal skills with a can-do attitude. They must be capable of multitasking, organising tasks and can work unsupervised. 
Please note, only those candidates successful in the shortlisting process will be contacted in the coming week for interviews. 

Please only apply if you have: 
	 Experience with heavy equipment mechanical repairs and maintenance 
	 Dedicated to maintaining and promoting safe work practices 
	 Strong commitment to meeting customer requirements 
	 Must hold a trade qualification 
	 Excellent written and verbal communication skills 
	 Min 5 years industry experience 
 
High quality tradesperson need only apply. 

Remuneration  
$75,000 - $95,000 per year Dependent on skills & Experience.  
Sloanebuilt Trailers offers regular overtime based on the Companies needs, overtime is additional to the above income range. 
Remuneration can be negotiated with the successful applicant at the interview stage. 

Remuneration will reflect current market conditions and industry award rates. To be discussed with the successful applicant. 

 High-quality tradesperson need only apply. 

Applicants will only be considered if they have the relevant qualifications and a minimum of 5 years’ experience within the Trailer Manufacturing Industry.

Expressions of interest and applications will be accepted for a minimum period of one (1) month from the date this advertisement is first published.

result.description:
Salary - 
$150,000 -  $170,000

Purpose – 
This role will lead the presales and solution consulting function for the organisation's enterprise SaaS platforms. Working at the intersection of sales, product and customers, the role is responsible for translating complex business requirements into tailored, value-led software solutions that win and grow strategic enterprise accounts. You will lead a team of solution consultants, and acts as the senior technical and commercial advisor throughout the enterprise sales cycle, with a particular focus on growth across the Asia-Pacific region, including Australia and New Zealand.

Key Responsibilities -
Solution Strategy & Deal Leadership
•	Define and own the presales and solution strategy for assigned enterprise and growth accounts across the product portfolio.
•	Lead customer discovery and requirement-gathering engagements, analysing current-state processes and designing target-state software solutions. 
•	Architect and present complex, multi-product solutions tailored to each customer's operational and commercial context. 
•	Engage senior and executive (CXO-level) stakeholders, articulating solution value through demonstrations, presentations and structured value narratives.
•	Develop return-on-investment and business-impact models that support commercial justification and value-led purchasing decisions. 
•	Support the sales organisation in qualifying, shaping and progressing opportunities through a substantial enterprise pipeline.

Team Leadership & Capability Development
•	Lead, coach and develop a team of senior presales / solution consultants, setting performance standards and supporting career growth.
•	Establish presales best practices, methodologies and quality standards for deliverables across the team.Cross-Functional Collaboration & Market Engagement.
•	Partner with the product organisation to channel structured customer feedback and influence roadmap priorities. 
•	Collaborate with sales, product, delivery and commercial teams to ensure proposed solutions are technically sound, deliverable and commercially viable.
•	Represent the organisation at industry events, forums and customer engagements to support pipeline generation and market visibility.

Selection Criteria – Skills, Qualifications & Experience
•	A bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline; a postgraduate management qualification is highly regarded.
•	Significant experience in enterprise SaaS presales, solution consulting or value engineering, including time in a leadership capacity.
•	Demonstrated success supporting and winning large, complex enterprise deals, ideally across multiple international markets.
•	Strong consultative selling, requirement-analysis, solution-design and commercial value-articulation skills.
•	Proven people-leadership experience, including managing and developing presales or solution-consulting teams.
•	Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, including engagement at executive level.
•	Familiarity with applying modern technologies, including generative AI, to sales and solution workflows.
•	Domain exposure to logistics, supply chain or comparable enterprise software environments is advantageous.

Scope -
The role leads a team of senior presales consultants. It carries accountability for solution outcomes on the organisation's most strategic enterprise opportunities and works closely with regional sales leadership to support revenue growth and market expansion across Asia-Pacific.
